definitions.explanation: The act of defending or protecting oneself from physical harm, psychological attack, or adverse situations. Encompasses both physical self-defense and broader protective measures such as information security and emotional boundaries.

examples.english: It is important to maintain an awareness of self-protection on a daily basis in preparation for disasters.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ (self) and ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧ (defense, protection). While it can refer to physical self-defense, it is used more broadly than its English equivalent. In psychology, it describes defensive emotional reactions; in daily life, it covers practical precautions against crime, fraud, disasters, and health risks.

The ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ prefix is highly productive, creating many important compounds: ⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧ (self-introduction), ⟦{自己責任|じこせきにん}→自己責任：20435_jikosekinin⟧ (self-responsibility), {自己管理|じこかんり} (self-management), and more.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己防衛|じこぼうえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: means of self-defense
- {自己防衛|じこぼうえい}⟦{本能|ほんのう}→本能：07623_honnou⟧: self-defense instinct
- {自己防衛|じこぼうえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: awareness of self-protection
- {自己防衛|じこぼうえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: for self-protection
- {自己防衛|じこぼうえい}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧: defensive reaction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}→正当防衛：18184_seitoubouei⟧: legitimate self-defense — the legal concept justifying use of force to protect oneself
- ⟦{護身|ごしん}→護身：19714_goshin⟧: self-defense — focuses on physical techniques and personal safety
- ⟦{自衛|じえい}→自衛：00121_jiei⟧: self-defense — often used in military/national security contexts (⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧ = Self-Defense Forces)
